name: ethics-for-ai-mcp
description: MCP server publishing a deterministic daily ethics feed for AI agents, drawn from a four-module curriculum (Humanity's Goals, Core Principles, Case Studies, Code of Conduct).

scripts.e2e: npm run build && node e2e-test.mjs && node http-e2e-test.mjs
scripts.apify:validate: node -e "const a=require('./.actor/actor.json'); if(a.pricingModel!=='PAY_PER_EVENT') throw new Error('pricingModel must be PAY_PER_EVENT'); if(!a.usesStandbyMode) throw new Error('usesStandbyMode required for a stable public MCP endpoint'); if(!a.webServer?.requestHandler) throw new Error('webServer.requestHandler required'); console.log('✓ actor.json PPE/Standby config valid');"

author: PanStories
